title: Remote Host Explorer project servers
description: Servers shown in the Remote Hosts view while this folder is open. Passwords and key passphrases are never stored here.

id.description: Stable unique identifier used to key stored secrets.

name.description: Display name shown in the Remote Hosts view.

enumDescriptions: SFTP over SSH (default port 22). Supports password or private key authentication.
FTP over TLS (default port 21). Uses explicit TLS (AUTH TLS), or implicit TLS when the port is 990. Password authentication; the server certificate is verified.
Plain FTP (default port 21). Password and file contents are sent unencrypted.

privateKeyPath.description: Path to an SSH private key. Setting this selects key authentication. A leading ~ means your home folder, e.g. ~/.ssh/id_rsa.

useSshAgent.description: SFTP only. Authenticate with the keys loaded in your running SSH agent (ssh-agent, or the OpenSSH Authentication Agent on Windows).

remoteRoot.description: Root path on the remote server shown in the Remote Hosts view.

mappings.description: Local folders linked to folders on the server, used for uploads, downloads, Compare, and auto-upload. When mapped folders are nested, the deepest one wins.

remotePath.description: Server folder that localPath corresponds to. Defaults to remoteRoot. Set it to browse a larger folder while mapping only part of it, for example a whole WordPress install with only the theme mapped.

localPath.description: Single local folder mapped to remoteMappedPath (or remoteRoot), as saved by earlier versions. Prefer mappings; both are honoured.

remoteMappedPath.description: Server folder that localPath corresponds to. Defaults to remoteRoot. Prefer mappings.

autoUpload.description: Automatically upload files inside a mapped local folder on save.

production.description: A live server: uploads, deletes, moves, renames, and other changes to its files ask for confirmation first, and it is shown in red.

ignoreGlobs.description: Paths relative to the mapped local folder that are skipped by auto-upload and recursive uploads/downloads. Supports *, ?, and **. When omitted, the defaults apply; set [] to ignore nothing.

useRsyncForUpload.description: Upload files via the rsync binary over ssh instead of SFTP put (requires local rsync/ssh binaries).

rsyncOptions.description: Extra flags passed to the rsync binary when useRsyncForUpload is enabled.
